item.name: The Plains
item.howToFind: Center of the island around the large Roblox spawn decal.
item.notableFeatures: Main spawn, densest natural toy spawns, heaviest player traffic, and the Green House and Pink House building plots. Touches the other major biomes.
item.playerUse: Default spawn hub and meetup area.
item.accessNotes: Open outdoor area with no special entry.
item.cardSummary: The largest biome and the main place players appear. Most naturally spawning toys and the busiest crowd sit here, with two house plots on the plains.

item.name: The Barn
item.howToFind: South of the Plains spawn area on the raised farm hill.
item.notableFeatures: Two-story red barn with a ladder to the upper floor, the Enclosed Field with two orbiting UFOs that fire radiation beams, a Silo with a climbable truss, and train tracks in front of the barn.
item.playerUse: Farm landmark and quieter outdoor hangout near the UFO field.
item.accessNotes: Open area. Use the wooden ladder inside the barn for the second floor.
item.cardSummary: The farm hill south of spawn. It holds the red barn, silo, and fenced field where two UFOs circle and beam the ground.

item.name: The Mountain
item.howToFind: North of spawn as the large mountain with snow on the highest peak.
item.notableFeatures: Second-largest open region, default snow on the summit, Mountain House landmark home, a slot machine, a train stop, and food plus furniture spawners near the house. Hollow Mountain sits inside this massif.
item.playerUse: Large quieter outdoor area and mountain landmark.
item.accessNotes: Open climbable mountain terrain. The Mountain House is a landmark home on the mountain and is not a building plot.
item.cardSummary: The big northern mountain with snow on top. It holds the Mountain House, a train stop, and the routes into Hollow Mountain.

item.name: The Beach
item.howToFind: Ocean edge on the right side of the map near the Green House and Pink House.
item.notableFeatures: Shoreline along the ocean beside the plains house plots.
item.accessNotes: Open shoreline with no special entry.
item.cardSummary: The seaside stretch by the Green and Pink Houses. Use it as a simple coastal landmark on the edge of the island.

item.name: Floating Island (Poison Factory)
item.howToFind: Raised island chained to a tall mountain, sitting above the Poison Pit.
item.notableFeatures: Fixed map landmark with the barren Poison Factory, two outdoor poison tanks, wide pipes that drop poison into the pits below, dark grass, and nearby floating rock pieces. Not the buyable Floating Island shop prop.
item.playerUse: Industrial hazard landmark above the poison pits.
item.accessNotes: Reach by climbing or flying onto the chained island. Standing poison damages players and applies a camera filter.
item.cardSummary: The chained factory island above the poison pits. It is a fixed map landmark with poison tanks and drop pipes, not the 1000-coin Floating Island shop item.

item.name: Poison Pit
item.howToFind: Directly under the Floating Island (Poison Factory).
item.notableFeatures: Two large pits that drop into a purple poison lake fed by the factory pipes above. Nearby landscape and the Poison House side are linked to poison staining.
item.playerUse: Hazard zone and factory undercroft landmark.
item.accessNotes: Open pits under the factory island. Poison damages players and filters the camera.
item.cardSummary: The twin pits under the factory island. Poison drains into a purple lake here, so treat it as a damage landmark rather than a safe hangout.

item.name: The Cave
item.howToFind: Under the blue house and Chinese house area, left of spawn.
item.notableFeatures: Cave passage the looping train runs through once each ride.
item.playerUse: Transit landmark and quieter passage near the house cluster.
item.accessNotes: Enter from the house side left of spawn. Indies of the Cove branches from the train-cave side.
item.cardSummary: The train tunnel under the blue and Chinese house area left of spawn. The train passes through once per loop.

item.name: Hollow Mountain
item.howToFind: Three entrances: front of the mountain left of the Green House, upper Crystal Caves, and a smaller hole on the ocean-facing back of the mountain.
item.notableFeatures: Large hollow interior inside The Mountain. Glitch-origin but durable, with tight spots players use to trap others.
item.playerUse: AFK space, quiet testing room, and hideout away from the Plains.
item.accessNotes: Front entrance is the best known. Crystal Caves top is the second route. The ocean-side hole is smaller and least known.
item.cardSummary: The hollow interior of The Mountain with three documented entrances. Players use it to AFK, hide, or test away from the spawn crowd.

item.name: Secret Area
item.howToFind: One entrance near the farm UFOs on the Enclosed Field side.
item.notableFeatures: Small enclosed hideout that players cover or block with props such as pallets.
item.playerUse: AFK hideout, small base, fights, or trapping runners.
item.accessNotes: Single entry point near the UFOs. Easy to miss if you never check the farm field edge.
item.cardSummary: A compact hideout entered near the farm UFOs. Players AFK here, build small bases, or block the only entrance with props.

item.name: Crystal Caves
item.howToFind: Just below The Mountain through a wooden cave entrance.
item.notableFeatures: Small dark cave under the mountain. Light sources matter inside, crystals can appear here, and an upper route connects into Hollow Mountain.
item.playerUse: Lesser-known dark stop and secondary path into Hollow Mountain.
item.accessNotes: Wooden entrance under the mountain. Treated as a dark area, so bring a light source if you need visibility.
item.cardSummary: A small dark cave under The Mountain. Most players overlook it, but the upper path can lead into Hollow Mountain.

item.name: Indies of the Cove
item.howToFind: Along the side of the train cave. Pass the crystal landmark, then look left for a peephole-style hole into the labyrinth.
item.notableFeatures: Secret labyrinth cave branched off the train-cave side. Hard to navigate once inside.
item.accessNotes: Easy to miss and easy to get lost. Wiki notes a thin prop such as a hay blade can help squeeze the peephole entry.
item.cardSummary: A secret maze cave off the train-cave side. Follow the crystal landmark, take the left peephole, and expect a confusing layout.

item.name: Building Plots
item.howToFind: Five sandbox house plots placed around the island, including Green House and Pink House on the Plains plus Chinese House and Blue House among the house cluster.
item.notableFeatures: Plot borders, grab and fling protection inside, member ranks (Owner, Co-Owner, Member, Requester), item builder trapdoor, save/load slots, and a house toys limit of 600. Confirmed plot houses: Pink House, Green House, Chinese House, and Blue House (Blue replaced White House), with Poison House tied to the blue/poison side. Mountain House is a mountain landmark home and is not a building plot.
item.playerUse: Protected free-build houses for bases, saves, and furniture or toy setups.
item.accessNotes: Requesters need acceptance to build. Owner tools and save/load are role-gated. Leaving a plot too long drops ranks unless you have Infinite House Time.
item.cardSummary: The island's sandbox houses where grab and fling are blocked inside the border. Build with the item builder, manage ranks, and save plot layouts on the five house plots.
